title: Retail shows strength in Chicago suburbs as DLC sells Mount Prospect shopping center for $95M
summary: DLC’s Adam Ifshin and Randhurst Village (DLC, Newmark)Investment momentum in the Chicago suburbs continued this week with a $95 million sale of a shopping center that last sold for $50 million in 2015. Elmsford, New York-based retail specialists DLC sold the Randhurst Village shopping center in Mount Prospect to Henderson, Nevada-based Rhino Investment Group after leading a turnaround effort of the property, which is anchored by Costco, Jewel-Osco and the Home Depot.
